data.name: PagerDuty - Authentication (via manual header)
data.description:
From the PagerDuty Developer Platform, read the documentation for Creating incidents using the REST API, and Authentication of REST API calls.
In PagerDuty
Generate a General Access REST API key as described in the PagerDuty docs.
In Postman
data.evaluateGuide:

Use for: list incidents, review incident status, inspect incident records
Not supported: creating, updating, or deleting incidents

data.name: Get oncalls
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves PagerDuty on-call schedules and assignments. Use it to identify who is currently or next on call.
Use for: find on-call responders, inspect rotations, review assignments
Not supported: changing schedules, assigning responders, managing incidents
